question: Hello Oda-sensei. I know it's a lot but could you tell us the best flower and animal that represents each of the Worst Generation?
answer: Coming right up. I don't know very much about flowers so don't look too deeply into my choices in the language of flowers! *Luffy: Sunflower, Monkey *Kid: Tulip, Fighting Bull *Law: Queen of the night, Snow Leopard *Blackbeard: Red spider lily, Hippo *Zoro: Wisteria, Shark *Killer: Snowdrop, Weasel *Hawkins: Black lily, Horse *Bonney: Freesia, Deer *Bege: Rose, Koala *Urouge: Daisy, Elephant *Apoo: Poppy, Orangutan *Drake: Gentiana, Allosaurus
name: Takusai
